ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Acoustic Scanner
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
GRAVSHIP_ACOUSTIC_SCANNER_1 — a gravship listens to the ground, in every biome.
Research acoustic sounding (after basic gravtech) and build an acoustic sounder on your gravship's substructure. Once the ship is landed and the sounder is powered, fire a sounding pulse: dust jumps off nearby walls, a bass thump runs through the hull, and a temporary overlay shows broad probability bands of what the ground gave back. Never exact cells: every reading is a coarse band, re-gridded on each pulse.
What it hears depends on the biome. Each biome supplies its own payload as a def extension on its BiomeDef (RimMandrake.AcousticScanner.RM_AcousticPayloadExtension), so adding a biome is pure XML. A biome with no payload reads "nothing unusual".
Mod Settings: master on/off, require a landed gravship, pulse effects, cooldown, overlay duration, range, and band size (floored at 7 cells).
